title: Meta, BlackRock partner on $14 billion El Paso data center venture
excerpt: Meta Platforms and the world's largest asset manager BlackRock on Tuesday announced a venture to develop and operate a data center campus in El Paso, Texas,...
content_html:
By Jaspreet Singh

July 28 (Reuters) - Meta Platforms and the world's largest asset manager BlackRock on Tuesday announced a venture to develop and operate a data center campus in El Paso, Texas, a project that would cost about $14 billion in development.

The ‌race to build out AI infrastructure has prompted tech giants to turn to debt sales worth tens of billions of ‌dollars and seek external capital from fund managers such as BlackRock due to an unprecedented scale of investment.

Meta said BlackRock-managed funds will take an 80% ownership stake in the ​venture, with Meta retaining the remaining 20%. A portion of BlackRock's investment will be financed through $12.5 billion in debt. Meta will also receive a $1 billion distribution to align ownership.

Meta will contribute land and in-progress construction assets worth about $2.3 billion, while BlackRock will make a cash contribution of about $4.9 billion, the company said.

The Facebook-parent will enter into lease agreements with the venture, allowing it to secure computing capacity without directly funding and owning the campus itself, ‌at a time when investors are concerned if ⁠data center investments will pay off.

Borrowing by tech companies has hit a fever pitch, with BofA Global Research saying that AI-related bond issuance reached $270 billion by early July this year, nearly doubling what was raised in all ⁠of 2025.

SCALE OF SPENDING RAISES QUESTIONS

Shares of Meta, which were down marginally in volatile trading on Tuesday, had fallen about 10% so far this year, as investors are scrutinizing the costs of AI expansion. The company is scheduled to report second-quarter results on July 29.

"The scale of spending still raises valid questions ​about ​cash flow, future operating costs, and investment returns, particularly as Meta doesn't (for now) ​have a large cloud business selling spare capacity to external ‌customers," said Matt Britzman, senior equity analyst, Hargreaves Lansdown.

Media reports, including by Reuters, said Meta is in talks to lease computing power to Anthropic in a potential deal worth up to $10 billion over two years.

Meta earlier said it was building an over $10 billion data center project in El Paso, near the Texas-New Mexico border, among 28 data centers it has in either operation or under construction in the U.S.

The El Paso data center campus, already under construction, is designed to provide 1 gigawatt of compute capacity, essential for Meta's AI technologies and supporting its core ‌business. Operations are expected to commence in 2028.

content_html_zh:
贾斯普雷特·辛格

7 月 28 日（路透社）- Meta Platforms 和全球最大的资产管理公司贝莱德周二宣布成立一家合资公司，在德克萨斯州埃尔帕索开发和运营数据中心园区，该项目的开发成本约为 140 亿美元。

由于投资规模空前，人工智能基础设施建设的竞赛促使科技巨头转向价值数百亿美元的债务销售，并向贝莱德等基金管理公司寻求外部资本。

Meta 表示，贝莱德管理的基金将持有该合资企业 80% 的股权，Meta 保留剩余的 20%。 贝莱德的部分投资将通过 125 亿美元的债务融资。 Meta 还将获得 10 亿美元的分配以调整所有权。

该公司表示，Meta 将贡献价值约 23 亿美元的土地和在建资产，而贝莱德将贡献约 49 亿美元的现金。

Facebook 母公司将与该合资企业签订租赁协议，使其能够在不直接资助和拥有园区本身的情况下获得计算能力，而此时投资者担心数据中心投资是否会得到回报。

科技公司的借贷已经达到了狂热的程度，美国银行全球研究部表示，截至今年 7 月初，与人工智能相关的债券发行量达到 2700 亿美元，几乎是 2025 年全年融资额的两倍。

支出规模引发问题

由于投资者正在仔细审查人工智能扩张的成本，Meta 的股价在周二的波动性交易中小幅下跌，今年迄今已下跌约 10%。 该公司定于7月29日公布第二季度业绩。

Hargreaves Lansdown 高级股票分析师马特·布里茨曼 (Matt Britzman) 表示：“支出规模仍然引发了有关现金流、未来运营成本和投资回报的合理问题，特别是因为 Meta（目前）没有向外部客户出售闲置产能的大型云业务。”

包括路透社在内的媒体报道称，Meta 正在就向 Anthropic 租赁计算能力进行谈判，该交易可能在两年内价值高达 100 亿美元。

Meta早些时候表示，它正在美国德克萨斯州和新墨西哥州边境附近的埃尔帕索建设一个价值超过100亿美元的数据中心项目，该项目是该公司在美国运营或在建的28个数据中心之一。

埃尔帕索数据中心园区已在建设中，旨在提供 1 吉瓦的计算能力，这对于 Meta 的人工智能技术和支持其核心业务至关重要。 预计将于 2028 年开始运营。
